add.note: Com números: add them up; sem objeto, pode significar 'fazer sentido'

add.pattern: add + extra + on / add on + noun
add.example: They added delivery on at the end
add.note: Também aparece como noun/adjective: an add-on feature

add.example: The delay added to everyone's frustration

build.pattern: build up + noun / build + noun + up
build.example: She built up her confidence over time

build.meaning: desenvolver a partir de uma base existente
build.example: The new plan builds on what worked last year

build.meaning: incorporar algo ao projeto ou estrutura
build.example: They built extra storage into the design
build.note: Padrão útil em tecnologia e design

close.example: The restaurant closed down last month
Let's close up the shop and go home
Police closed the street off after the accident

do.example: I had to do the whole form over
do.note: Uso especialmente comum no inglês americano

do.example: We can do without a car for a few days
The company did away with the old approval process

draw.example: The lawyer drew up the contract
draw.note: Muito comum com contract, agreement, plan e list

draw.meaning: recorrer a experiência, conhecimento ou recurso
draw.example: She drew on years of experience to solve the problem
The interviewer managed to draw him out

grow.meaning: crescer e chegar à vida adulta
grow.pattern: grow up / grow up in + place
grow.example: She grew up in a small town

grow.meaning: desenvolver-se até se tornar; passar a caber
grow.example: He grew into the role faster than expected

grow.meaning: deixar de caber; superar fase ou hábito
grow.example: The kids grew out of their winter coats

pay.example: I'll pay you back on Friday

pay.pattern: pay off + debt / effort + pay off
pay.example: All that extra practice finally paid off

pay.note: Também: pay for a mistake = sofrer a consequência

pay.meaning: pagar ou desembolsar uma quantia, especialmente indenização/prêmio
pay.pattern: pay out + money / pay + amount + out
pay.example: The insurer paid out the claim within a week

play.pattern: play along / play along with + person/idea
play.example: I knew it was a joke, but I played along
Can you play the recording back?
The company tried to play the problem down

play.meaning: dar destaque; comportar-se mal ou falhar
play.pattern: play + strength/issue + up / device + play up
play.example: The ad plays up the product's low price
play.note: No inglês britânico, a device can play up = apresentar problema

read.example: Read the email over before you send it

read.meaning: ler do início ao fim ou examinar cuidadosamente
read.example: I read through the contract twice

read.meaning: estudar um assunto por conta própria
read.example: I read up on the company before the interview

see.meaning: despedir-se de alguém que está partindo; repelir
see.example: We went to the station to see her off

see.meaning: perceber a verdade por trás de algo; acompanhar até o fim
see.pattern: see through + trick/person / see + project + through
see.example: She saw through his excuse immediately
see.note: Com projeto: see it through = levar até o fim

see.meaning: cuidar de ou garantir que algo seja resolvido
see.example: I'll see to the booking this afternoon

send.example: I sent the shoes back because they didn't fit
She sent in her application yesterday

send.meaning: distribuir ou enviar para várias pessoas
send.example: We sent the invitations out last week
I sent the documents off this morning
send.note: Também: give someone a send-off = despedida

speak.example: Could you speak up a little?
speak.note: Também pode significar defender sua opinião

speak.example: Several employees spoke out against the decision

speak.meaning: representar ou expressar a opinião de alguém/grupo
speak.example: I can only speak for myself

start.meaning: começar de determinada forma ou posição
start.example: She started out as an assistant

start.meaning: começar uma atividade, processo ou período
start.example: Let's start off with a quick review
The file was corrupted, so I had to start over

stop.example: I'll stop by the store on my way home

stop.meaning: fazer uma parada curta no caminho
stop.example: We stopped off at a café before continuing

stop.meaning: fazer escala ou passar curto período em um lugar durante viagem
stop.example: We stopped over in Lisbon for one night

walk.pattern: walk away / walk away from + noun
walk.example: She walked away from the argument before it got worse

walk.pattern: walk out / walk out of + place
walk.example: He walked out of the meeting without saying anything
walk.note: Também usado para greve: workers walked out

walk.meaning: afastar-se andando; tentar aliviar algo caminhando
walk.example: We walked off the heavy lunch by exploring the neighborhood

wear.example: Those shoes wore out in less than a year
wear.note: Com pessoa: The trip wore me out

wear.example: The painkiller started to wear off after a few hours
The constant delays eventually wore everyone down
